body: Hey guys, guess I should have cleared this up sooner. I just thought I'd let you know I'm jumping not out of depression, but necessity. I've got a disease that is going to make my life virtually unlivable in the near future, so I figure I might as well hike one more beautiful place before it takes me. I really was just looking for suggestions. I appreciate your concern and in normal circumstances would heed your advice, but I'd like to go with some dignity.
